vision.name: Orange Bicycle Kick
vision.text:
[Attack] Physical attack.
Lower a player's anger 2 levels. Rejuvenate up to 3 Drills you control. Search your Life Deck for X ∞ Styled Drills and place them into play. X = the number of Drills you Rejuvenated.
DAMAGE: AT + 5 stages.
(Banish after use.)
vision.review: printed oddities: card type reads Energy Combat but the attack line says 'Physical attack'; a stray infinity (Continuous) symbol is printed between 'X' and 'Styled Drills'
vision.note: stray '∞' transcribed as printed (zoomed); no Endurance badge
